integrity: The proof is self-contained. The exact vertex defect is reduced to a two-square identity; deterministic coordinate checks are supplemental and not used as a proof of the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only n=4 and uses supporting-line distances. The 2016 source paper was not directly retrievable during the literature check; its indexed metadata and the public conjecture identify the prior proved scope as n=3. Unindexed or differently phrased coverage remains a residual originality risk.
title: The cyclic-quadrilateral case of the tangent-line Erdős–Mordell conjecture
